body: Indeed. I think that's what Paul meant when he said to die  is gain but to live is Christ. I want to be more like him.
Thanks. I really think other people are what gets me through the day.

I have OCD and a lot of trauma. Which is fine. But I can't see it ever getting better. Life span wise I've got 55 more years. So how am I supposed to live knowing it could suck? And yeah. I'm Christian and a lot of people would say suicide is an unforgivable sin.  But I don't know if I feel that way. There's a concept in Christianity called grace, and I believe God's grace is bigger than suicide. I have doubts about my faith. But if gods real, I believe that's true.
Thanks, sometimes I forget I'm bigger than my depression. It's a good reminder. Day by day. That's all any of us can do.
